requirements.statement: Each form field meets one of the listed labelling conditions.

citations.quote: Chaque champ de formulaire vérifie-t-il une de ces conditions
Pour chaque champ de formulaire, vérifier que le champ de formulaire :

routes.statement: The field has an aria-labelledby attribute referencing an identified text passage: one or more passages whose id values are unique in the page.

citations.quote: Le champ de formulaire possède un attribut WAI-ARIA `aria-labelledby` référençant un passage de texte identifié

citations.entry: Passage de texte lié par `aria-labelledby` ou `aria-describedby`
citations.quote: Il s’agit d’un ou de plusieurs passages de texte identifiés par des id dont la valeur est unique dans la page

routes.statement: The field has an aria-label attribute.

citations.quote: Le champ de formulaire possède un attribut WAI-ARIA `aria-label`

routes.statement: A <label> element with a for attribute is associated with the field.

citations.quote: Une balise `<label>` ayant un attribut `for` est associée au champ de formulaire

routes.statement: The field has a title attribute.

citations.quote: Le champ de formulaire possède un attribut `title`

routes.statement: An adjacent button gives the field a visible label, and a visually hidden <label>, or an aria-label, aria-labelledby or title attribute, gives it an accessible name.

citations.quote: Un bouton adjacent au champ de formulaire lui fournit une étiquette visible et un élément `<label>` visuellement caché ou un attribut WAI-ARIA `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` ou `title` lui fournit un nom accessible.

routes.statement: A <label> element without a for attribute contains the field. The test lines name only a label with for, but the glossary's definition of a label accepts the <label> element without that condition; listed so that no fault rests on excluding it.

citations.quote: Chaque champ de formulaire a-t-il une étiquette

exceptions.statement: Inputs of type submit, reset, hidden, image and button, <button> elements and elements with role="button" are not form fields.

citations.quote: Les objets de formulaires et rôle WAI-ARIA suivants ne sont pas considérés comme des champs de formulaires :

rationale.text: The test lists five conditions, any one of which labels a field. The glossary's label entry also names the <label> element without requiring for, so I added a sixth route for a label that contains the field: claiming less is safer than failing a field an auditor may accept. The five axe rules are evidence only, each with partial scope. label and select-name cover only native inputs, textareas and selects; they accept a placeholder, which no route accepts, and role none or presentation, so their clean result proves nothing; and they fault an empty aria-label or a label with no text, which literally has the attribute or the label, so their fault proves nothing either. aria-input-field-name, aria-progressbar-name and aria-meter-name cover only some ARIA roles, and role=meter is not in the glossary's list of field roles. The custom check's fault is narrow: a field, as the glossary lists them, that is rendered and exposed to assistive technologies and has no aria-labelledby, no aria-label, no title, no associated label and no label ancestor. Every route needs at least one of these, the adjacent-button route included, so such a field meets none and the test fails. Everything else is cannot_tell, including empty values and broken references: the wording asks that the field has the attribute or an associated label, and does not say whether an empty attribute or a reference to a missing id meets that. The check does not decide options, optgroups, datalists, or the roles option, checkbox, radio and switch, which can take a name from their content (not a route the test names), nor a combobox wrapping a text input; so its scope is partial. The entry is fail_only, not full, because the adjacent-button route needs judgment (a visible label given by a button next to the field). Applicability is judgment: the glossary includes ARIA roles whose presence code can see, but also options and similar elements on which the test is unclear. Needs is empty.

citations.quote: Si c’est le cas pour champ de formulaire, **le test est validé**.
